profile.headline: Software Engineer @ L3Harris | Cleared
profile.summary:
Graduated with High Honors as a Software Engineer at the University of Puerto Rico - Mayaguez.
Currently working for L3Harris as a Software Engineer.
Great doing solo work or with a team. Interested in AI/ML, DevOps, Web Development, and Application Development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Automate and improve our team's CI/CD pipeline on Jenkins. Implement features and improve the efficiency of our team's Anaconda packager tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: C# Web Developer to implement new and improve upon features on L3Harris's managerial website.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Development Operations for constructing a pipeline framework to automate projects' CI/CD through Jenkins. Create a pipeline to create code skeleton in JAVA or C++ from UML/SysML and vice versa (code to UML) using CAMEO and Eclipse IDE.
positions.insights: Groovy, Microsoft Visual Studio Code and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: AI/ML Behavioral Modeling. Research and implement an AI model to predict an object's future position and speed.
